title: Emit logs as structured JSON
body:
Free-text logs can't be reliably analyzed: extracting an error's level, exception or stack, or filtering by a correlation id, means fragile regex over multi-line output. The observability stack (Loki) and the self-healing-loop design note both depend on structured logs.

Artemis emits one JSON object per log event when containerized (LOG_FORMAT=json) and human-readable text in local dev. Fields follow the constellation-wide schema. Implementation is one dependency (logstash-logback-encoder) plus a logback.xml change. Log format only; no behavioral change.
